_note: Made up for this course, except forecastPlace, which is real (see its _source). Kijani Estate is a fictional place. There are no volunteer names or contacts: the product counts places only. Rain limits are invented, not safety rules. Copy this file to data/challenges/community-clean-up-planner.json in your team repository.

forecastPlace._source: Open-Meteo Geocoding API (https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search), which uses GeoNames data under CC BY 4.0. Checked 11 Nov 2026. Coordinates rounded to four decimal places.
